title: E2E Test Job - Backend Engineer
shortDescription: We are looking for a skilled Backend Engineer to join our growing engineering team. You will design and build scalable REST APIs, own microservice infrastructure, and collaborate with frontend and data teams to deliver high-quality product features.
fullDescription:
Responsibilities:
- Design, implement, and maintain high-performance REST APIs using Node.js / NestJS
- Build and optimise relational database schemas (PostgreSQL)
- Write clean, well-tested TypeScript code with >80% unit-test coverage
- Participate in code reviews and mentor junior developers
- Collaborate with DevOps to manage CI/CD pipelines on GitHub Actions

Requirements:
- 3-5 years of professional backend development experience
- Proficiency in TypeScript / Node.js and RESTful API design
- Experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, and message queues (RabbitMQ or Kafka)
- Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (AWS / GCP)
- Strong communication skills and ability to work in an Agile team

Nice to have:
- Experience with GraphQL or gRPC
- Contributions to open-source projects
educationLevel: Bachelor in Computer Science or related field
